text:
## Purpose  
Establish procedures for managing Direct Debits, including mandate collection, processing, dispute handling, and cancellation, ensuring compliance with Direct Debit Scheme rules and customer protection.

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit Management Process
raw_entities.description: End-to-end procedure for managing Direct Debits on customer accounts, encompassing mandate collection, processing, dispute handling, and cancellation. The process ensures compliance with Direct Debit Scheme rules and maintains customer protection throughout the lifecycle of direct debit arrangements.
context: Establish procedures for managing Direct Debits, including mandate collection, processing, dispute handling, and cancellation
ensuring compliance with Direct Debit Scheme rules and customer protection

raw_entities.name: Direct Debit Mandate
raw_entities.description: The formal authorization collected from a customer to permit recurring payments from their account. Mandate collection is a key component of the Direct Debit Management Process and must comply with Direct Debit Scheme rules.

Direct Debit Scheme rules and customer protection
